actual_rule_observed: With no order key in the default theme, sibling sidebar entries render in exact themeConfig.sidebar items-array order: Probe A then Probe B, matching the config sequence with no reordering.

frontmatter_used.title: Probe A / Probe B (one per file)

notes: NOT-APPLICABLE as a tie-break probe: the VitePress default theme defines no 'order' key or any tie concept for sidebar entries, so there is nothing to tie on. Closest analogue executed instead: appended { text: 'Probe A', link: '/probe-a' } then { text: 'Probe B', link: '/probe-b' } to the same sidebar group's items array. Rendered flattened indices 3 and 4 respectively — config array order preserved verbatim, no sorting or tie-breaking applied. landed_at_index=3 refers to the first added entry (Probe A); Probe B landed at 4.
